title: Investing Implications of the “Ghibli Boom”
summary: AI production economics, search monetization and liquidity.
coverage_note: Read all blocks, including art examples, legal discussion, media analogies, search economics and investment watchlists. framework_lessons: Trace lower production costs through distribution, attention and monetization.
assessment: The strongest verified insight is the distinction between falling publisher traffic and search-platform monetization. The media analogies are uneven: recorded music recovered, but piracy does not generally cause higher book sales. The AI investment discussion is mostly scenarios and watchlists, with useful unit-economics questions but few fixed-horizon forecasts.
verification_limitations: Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
